# AssembleAtEase: full price list

> Every fixed price a customer can book at https://www.assembleatease.com/book. Prices are per piece, before Texas sales tax. Add-ons are booked with a main item, not on their own. Anything not listed is priced by custom quote.

- Services: Furniture Assembly, Mounting & Hanging, Smart Home, Fitness Equipment, Outdoor & Playsets, Office Assembly, and custom quotes for anything else.
- Where: Texas. Core areas are the Austin metro and the San Antonio metro, where a local pro is matched automatically. Other Texas ZIP codes can book and are confirmed by our team.
- Prices: fixed and itemized per piece, shown before booking. Texas sales tax is added at checkout.
- Payment: you pay after the work is done. A hold for the total is placed on your card before the appointment.
- Cancellation: free up to 24 hours before the appointment. Inside 24 hours, once a pro has accepted the job, a 10% fee on the service price applies, or 15% when the pro is already on the way or it is under 2 hours. No fee applies if no pro has accepted. A booking that was rescheduled no longer has the free window.
- Custom quotes: no card is needed to ask. We email a price; you approve it and add a card to book.
- The pros (called Easers) are independent contractors who bring their own tools.
- Contact: (979) 232-5139, service@assembleatease.com. Phone and email hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 8 PM; Saturday and Sunday, 8 AM to 8 PM. Booking online is open any time.
